effect_description_eng: {Hand} [Main] If you have a Tamer with [Tomoro Tenma] in its name, by placing 1 [Armalizamon] from your trash as any of your [Gekkomon]'s bottom digivolution card, that Digimon digivolves into this card, ignoring level. [On Play] [When Digivolving] You may suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers. Then, by trashing the bottom face-down card from under any of your Tamers, 1 of their Digimon or Tamers can't unsuspend until their turn ends.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [End of Attack] [Once Per Turn] By trashing the bottom face-down card from under any of your Tamers, this [Glowing Dawn] trait Digimon unsuspends.
